query:
When Cecilia proposed a pre-session group meal, the arrangement seemed to have broad support. Who in the group went along but revealed through their response what their actual preference was, and what specifically in their reply tells you that?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Harriet
C. Marcus
D. Dev
context:
[1] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:36:00) ok back to Feb 17th logistics, do we want to do the group meal first or go straight to site? I was thinking Thai takeaway at mine at 6:30 then car share to Blackmoor by 8? 🍜🌟
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:22:00) Ruth and I met at the county natural-history society in 2021 and discovered within about twenty minutes that we both preferred the stars to anything else on the programme. We agreed to meet the following Friday with our own telescopes in my back garden. There were two of us, a 4-inch refractor, Ruth's old 80mm, and a thermos of tea. I remember we stayed out until 2am on a school night and neither of us could see the point of going in. It grew from there one person at a time. In my experience the quiet beginning is the only honest beginning a group like this can have.
[3] (about=Harriet, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:20:00) I want to pick up the thread Harriet left last month about how this group started. Nadia, can I ask you properly: what was it like the first time you got people together in your back garden? You and Ruth, was it just the two of you at first?
[4] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:29:00) Harriet, what was the Bortle class?
[5] (about=Harriet, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:49:00) Unanimous then, or nearly. I will note for the record that I pushed for darker sites before the weekend and I am gratified. But I want to add something: this group started in Nadia's back garden, did it not? Nadia, Ruth, you two dragged everyone here. I think people forget that the whole thing was your idea originally.
[6] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[7] (about=Priya, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:39:00) same, I'll probably head direct. I've got a supervision call until 6 anyway so I'd barely make the food
agent_answer:
**A. Priya**  
Her reply reveals her actual preference: she said she **“will head direct to site on Feb 17th”** because she **“has a supervision call until 6 so would barely make the food.”** That shows she was effectively siding with skipping the group meal / going straight to the site, rather than genuinely opting into the pre-session dinner.
